port.description: OS-assigned ephemeral port, listener active only during login

get.summary: Receive the Google native authorization response
get.description: Loopback only. An unpredictable per-attempt state authenticates the response; authorization codes are single-use and exchanged with S256 PKCE. No CORS or public service. Reject duplicate parameters, wrong or missing state, and code/error combinations. Invalid state does not consume a pending login. Close after one valid success/denial, cancel or timeout. Do not log URLs or response values.

200.description: Matching state and one authorization code accepted; static return-to-app plain text

400.description: Malformed, duplicate or ambiguous parameters; static plain text

403.description: Missing/incorrect state, or matching-state consent denial; static plain text
